summary: Ethos Technologies filed an Item 8.01 8-K furnishing an updated beneficial ownership table as of September 30, 2026, ahead of the December 2026 Russell indices reconstitution. The filing discloses ownership based on 41,714,064 Class A and 23,269,929 Class B shares outstanding, covering named executive officers, directors, the officer-director group, and 5% holders per Regulation S-K Rule 403. No transaction, price, premium, or advisor is disclosed, and the company cautions index eligibility may be calculated differently. This is a routine disclosure update, not a special situation; watch only for index-inclusion mechanics.
